name: pairspan-mac
description: Wireless ADB bridge between a Mac and an Android phone.
author: Ferhat Özçelik

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/main.js && cross-env PAIRSPAN_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-electron',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.dist: node scripts/fetch-mac-adb.mjs && npm run build && mkdir -p pack && sips -z 1024 1024 assets/icon.png --out pack/icon.png && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-win-adb.mjs && npm run build && mkdir -p pack && sips -z 1024 1024 assets/icon.png --out pack/icon.png && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:signed: node scripts/fetch-mac-adb.mjs && npm run build && mkdir -p pack && sips -z 1024 1024 assets/icon.png --out pack/icon.png && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal -c.mac.identity="$CSC_NAME" -c.mac.notarize=true
